description: This Java class 'SuggestionsProvider' manages dictionaries and suggestions for an Android keyboard application. It handles loading dictionaries, providing word suggestions, auto-corrections, and managing user and contact dictionaries, with support for background loading and preferences.

classes.name: SuggestionsProvider
classes.description: Main class providing suggestions, managing dictionaries, and handling user preferences for an Android keyboard app.

classes.name: ContactsDictionaryLoaderListener
classes.description: Inner class implementing a listener for loading contact dictionaries asynchronously.

classes.name: NullDictionary
classes.description: A static placeholder dictionary that does not contain any words.

classes.name: NULL_NEXT_WORD_SUGGESTIONS
classes.description: A static placeholder for next word suggestions that returns empty results.

methods.name: setupSuggestionsForKeyboard
methods.description: Configures dictionaries and suggestions based on provided dictionary builders and a callback.

methods.name: createRealContactsDictionary
methods.description: Creates an instance of the real contacts dictionary.

methods.name: calculateHashCodeForBuilders
methods.description: Calculates a hash code for a list of dictionary builders to detect changes.

methods.name: createUserDictionaryForLocale
methods.description: Creates a user dictionary for a specific locale.

methods.name: removeWordFromUserDictionary
methods.description: Removes a word from all user dictionaries.

methods.name: addWordToUserDictionary
methods.description: Adds a new word to the primary user dictionary if not in incognito mode.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a word is valid across all dictionaries.

methods.name: isIncognitoMode
methods.description: Returns whether incognito mode is active.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Clears all dictionaries and disposables, resetting the provider.

methods.name: resetNextWordSentence
methods.description: Resets the state of next word suggestions.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Provides word suggestions based on current input.

methods.name: getNextWords
methods.description: Provides next word suggestions based on current word.

methods.name: tryToLearnNewWord
methods.description: Attempts to learn a new word into the auto-dictionary.
